content.text:
The migration from the Pages Router to the App Router is done. Summary of changes:

## Migration Summary

### Layout & structure
- **`app/layout.tsx`** – Root layout replacing `_app.js` and `_document.js`, with metadata, fonts, `AppProvider`, header, nav, and footer
- **`app/global-error.tsx`** – Root error boundary for server errors

### Pages
- **`app/page.tsx`** – Home page (SSR) using `headers()` instead of `getServerSideProps`
- **`app/blog/page.tsx`** – Blog index with ISR (`revalidate: 60`) instead of `getStaticProps`
- **`app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`** – Blog post with `generateStaticParams` and `generateMetadata` instead of `getStaticPaths` and `getStaticProps`
- **`app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx`** – Loading UI for dynamic routes
- **`app/not-found.tsx`** – 404 page (replaces `pages/404.js`)
- **`app/error.tsx`** – Client error boundary (replaces `pages/_error.js`)

### API routes
- **`app/api/posts/route.ts`** – GET and POST handlers (replaces `pages/api/posts/index.js`)
- **`app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts`** – GET, PUT, DELETE handlers (replaces `pages/api/posts/[id].js`)

### Components
- **`components/AppProvider.tsx`** – Converted to TypeScript with types; marked `'use client'` for client-only hooks
- **`app/blog/BlogPostLinks.tsx`** – Client component for the “Read More” button
- **`app/blog/[id]/BackButton.tsx`** – Client component for the back button
- **`app/GoHomeButton.tsx`** – Client component for the 404 “Go Back Home” button

### API changes
| Pages Router | App Router |
|--------------|------------|
| `getServerSideProps` | Async Server Components + `headers()` |
| `getStaticProps` | Async Server Components + `fetch` with `next: { revalidate }` |
| `getStaticPaths` | `generateStaticParams` |
| `fallback: 'blocking'` | `dynamicParams: true` + `loading.tsx` |
| `Head` | `metadata` export / `generateMetadata` |
| `useRouter` from `next/router` | `useRouter` from `next/navigation` |
| API route `(req, res)` | Route Handlers with `Request` / `NextResponse` |

The `pages` directory has been removed and the build completes successfully.

- **`app/blog/page.tsx`** – Blog index with ISR (`revalidate: 60`) instead of `getStaticProps`
- **`app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`** – Blog post with `generateStaticParams` and `generateMetadata` instead of `getStaticPaths` and `getStaticProps`
- **`app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx`** – Loading UI for dynamic routes
- **`app/not-found.tsx`** – 404 page (replaces `pages/404.js`)
- **`app/error.tsx`** – Client error boundary (replaces `pages/_error.js`)

### API routes
- **`app/api/posts/route.ts`** – GET and POST handlers (replaces `pages/api/posts/index.js`)
- **`app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts`** – GET, PUT, DELETE handlers (replaces `pages/api/posts/[id].js`)

### Components
- **`components/AppProvider.tsx`** – Converted to TypeScript with types; marked `'use client'` for client-only hooks
- **`app/blog/BlogPostLinks.tsx`** – Client component for the “Read More” button
- **`app/blog/[id]/BackButton.tsx`** – Client component for the back button
- **`app/GoHomeButton.tsx`** – Client component for the 404 “Go Back Home” button

### API changes
| Pages Router | App Router |
|--------------|------------|
| `getServerSideProps` | Async Server Components + `headers()` |

| `getStaticPaths` | `generateStaticParams` |
